caption: The drawing depicts a wooden desk with a brown finish, shown in three views on a plain, light-colored background. The central and largest view shows the desk from the front with the writing surface folded down, revealing interior compartments and drawers, all shaded in brown tones. The main compartment contains two vertical dividers in the center and curved wooden details, as well as small drawers on both the left and right sides. The lower portion appears as a rectangular chest with three horizontal sections, supported by four legs, each indented in a decorative fashion near the base. In the upper left corner is a simple line sketch showing a partial side profile of the leg detail and thickness of the desk, while in the upper right corner is a line drawing of the desk in its closed form, showing the full chest, closed writing surface, and all four legs. The overall composition combines colored and uncolored line drawings on a blank background.
title: Desk
